name: Merquly AI Search for WooCommerce
author: speedpirsum

sections.description:
Merquly helps WooCommerce shoppers find products by describing what they need. Add a conversational search widget, show an AI overview above ordinary search results, and answer store questions using content you choose.

A Merquly account and connection to the hosted Merquly service are required. A free service plan is available; paid plans provide larger allowances. The WordPress plugin connects your store to the service, which performs product indexing, semantic retrieval, and answer generation.

Product discovery in natural language

Shoppers can ask for products by purpose, budget, attributes, or audience, then refine their request with follow-up messages. Merquly uses the synchronized catalog to return product suggestions with links to your store.

Example requests include:

  • “Show me backpacks for hiking.”
  • “Find weights for home workouts.”
  • “Do you have pink bags under $50?”

Results depend on the products, attributes, and content available in your store. AI-generated answers can contain mistakes and should be checked when accuracy matters.

Answers from selected store content

Choose which pages, posts, and supported custom post types may be used to answer questions. Useful sources include shipping policies, returns information, FAQs, and store information.

The plugin extracts supported rendered content from the standard editor, Gutenberg, Elementor, and WPBakery. Content extraction depends on how a page builder or extension stores and renders its content. Large sources are split into searchable sections by the service.

The current version does not look up individual customer orders or order status.

Storefront experiences

  • Floating AI chat widget with follow-up questions and product suggestions.
  • Optional AI overview above standard WordPress or WooCommerce search results.
  • Follow-up input in the search overview when a shopper needs to clarify a request.
  • Product links and, where available, links to selected page or post sources.
  • Separate controls for enabling the widget and standard-search overview.
  • Adjustable vertical position for the floating widget.
  • Optional Merquly attribution links, disabled by default.

Catalog and synchronization

  • Synchronize eligible published WooCommerce products, including titles, descriptions, SKUs, prices, stock status, categories, tags, attributes, and public image URLs.
  • Exclude individual products or whole product categories.
  • Process product additions, edits, deletions, and selected-content changes through background queues.
  • Run a full catalog synchronization from the control panel when needed.
  • Use the optional Daily Light Sync as an additional synchronization check.
  • Review indexing status, search analytics, queries needing attention, and shopper feedback in WordPress.

Queued changes are processed through WooCommerce Action Scheduler when available, with WP-Cron as a fallback. Background processing requires a functioning scheduler on your site. No custom server installation is needed on the store’s hosting account.

Account and service plans

Create an account at merquly.com, copy your Merquly license key, and connect your store in the setup wizard. You do not need to supply your own AI-provider API key.

The free hosted-service plan currently includes up to 100 indexed products, 3 content sources, and 100 AI searches per month. Starter, Growth, and Pro offer larger service allowances. Monthly and yearly billing are available for paid plans. Search allowances reset monthly, including on yearly billing.

For current allowances and pricing, visit Merquly Pricing. Paid service subscriptions are purchased on the Merquly website; WooCommerce Subscriptions is not required on your store.

External service and data use

This plugin relies on the hosted Merquly service at https://api.merquly.com. Connecting the store with a Merquly license key authorizes communication with this service. Indexing and search require this connection and do not run entirely inside WordPress.

Depending on the administrator’s configuration and actions, the plugin sends:

  • The site’s public domain, plugin version, license key during activation, and an installation credential on later authenticated requests.
  • Public product data selected for indexing, including product IDs, names, descriptions, SKUs, prices, stock status, categories, tags, attributes, public taxonomies, product URLs, and image URLs.
  • Rendered text and source metadata from pages, posts, or supported custom posts explicitly selected by an administrator.
  • Public shipping-method and payment-method names, descriptions, supported features, and non-secret public settings. Passwords, private keys, API keys, tokens, and other credential-like settings are excluded.
  • Storefront search questions, recent chat context, language, search preferences, and a pseudonymous browser identifier used for rate limiting and aggregate quality measurement.
  • Optional helpful or not-helpful feedback submitted by a shopper.

License and service-status requests are made when connecting or checking the store’s connection. Product and content information is sent during requested synchronization and subsequent background updates. Search questions and chat context are sent when a shopper submits a request; feedback is sent when a shopper submits it.

This information is used to provide search results, generate answers, maintain the store index, enforce service allowances, prevent abuse, and present store-level search analytics. Query-level quality records are retained for no more than seven days by the current service configuration; aggregated counters may be retained separately.

The current version does not index WooCommerce orders, customer billing records, or payment credentials. Shoppers should avoid entering personal or sensitive information into the assistant.

  • Service: Merquly
  • Privacy policy: Merquly Privacy Policy
  • Terms: Merquly Terms of Service

Privacy

Merquly is a hosted service. Review the External service and data use section, the service privacy policy, and the terms before connecting a store.

Store owners are responsible for providing notices and obtaining any consent required for their store and shoppers. Do not select sources containing customer personal information, credentials, order details, or other confidential data. AI-generated answers should be reviewed when accuracy matters.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  2. Install Merquly AI Search for WooCommerce from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin ZIP, then activate it.
  3. Create or sign in to your account at merquly.com.
  4. Copy your Merquly license key from My Account > AI Search License.
  5. In your store’s WordPress dashboard, open AI Search by Merquly > Setup Wizard.
  6. Connect the store with your license key.
  7. Synchronize products. You can exclude products or categories before synchronization, or continue setup and synchronize later from the control panel.
  8. Select any store content you want the assistant to use, then choose which storefront search experiences to enable.
  9. Check the control panel for synchronization progress and test the search on your storefront.

Requirements: WordPress 6.5 or later, PHP 8.0 or later, WooCommerce, an internet connection to the Merquly service, and working Action Scheduler or WP-Cron processing.
sections.faq:
Is the plugin free?

The WordPress plugin is free to install. Its search and indexing features use the Merquly hosted service, which offers a free plan and paid plans with larger allowances. A Merquly account and license key are required for both.

Do I need my own AI-provider account or API key?

No. Connect your Merquly account using the Merquly license key shown in your account dashboard. Merquly manages the AI service.

Do I need WooCommerce Subscriptions on my store?

No. Your store needs WooCommerce. Merquly service subscriptions are managed separately on merquly.com.

Does this replace ordinary WooCommerce search?

The optional standard-search integration displays an AI overview above the ordinary search results. Standard results remain available below it. The floating chat widget can also be enabled separately.

Which products and pages are synchronized?

Eligible published products are synchronized subject to your exclusions and service allowance. Only content sources explicitly selected by an administrator are indexed. Do not select private or confidential content as a source.

Can I exclude products or categories?

Yes. You can exclude individual products and whole product categories. Removing a previously indexed product through these controls queues its removal from the hosted index.

Does it support Elementor, Gutenberg, and WPBakery content?

The plugin supports extraction of rendered content from these editors and the standard WordPress editor. Some custom widgets, shortcodes, or dynamically generated sections may require checking the extracted content after synchronization.

What happens when a product changes?

Product changes are queued for background synchronization. Repeated changes to the same product are combined in the queue where possible. You can inspect pending work in the control panel and run the queue manually when needed. A working scheduler is required for automatic processing.

What happens when the monthly AI search allowance runs out?

The service stops accepting additional AI search and chat requests until the allowance resets, eligible extra searches are added, or the plan is upgraded. Standard WooCommerce search remains available. Product synchronization does not consume the storefront search allowance.

Can the assistant answer questions about a customer’s order?

No. The current version does not index orders or provide authenticated order-status lookup. It can answer general store questions using selected information sources.

Does the plugin send payment credentials or customer billing data?

No. Public payment-method descriptions can be synchronized as store information, but credential-like settings, customer billing records, and orders are not indexed.

Can I hide the Powered by Merquly link?

Yes. Attribution links are optional and disabled by default. The Show Merquly attribution links setting controls the search-overview credit and the link in the chat heading. These links are not required for search to work.

Where can I get help?

See Merquly Help for setup and troubleshooting information. You can also use the WordPress.org support forum. Do not post license keys, installation credentials, or private customer information in public support requests.
